counting_contract.base: 2 times existing THOP counters, the project's legacy convention; normalization uses THOP approximation
counting_contract.einsum: 2*product(unique index dimensions), standard dense contraction MAC convention
counting_contract.scan: 6*B*D*L*N factored real variable-B/C recurrence arithmetic; +BDL for delta_bias; +2BDL for D*u; +BDL for softplus addition
not_included: scan exponentials/softplus special functions (symbolic counts supplied per call)
all other functional elementwise arithmetic, activations, statistics, and interpolation not covered by THOP
CUDA parallel-prefix overhead, address arithmetic, memory movement, preprocessing and task postprocessing
counting_contract.interpretation: covered-operation estimate for complete models; not exact total FLOPs, latency or GPU instruction count; do not compare as identical coverage to legacy THOP-only numbers
